justification: The company needs a documented policy and responsibilities to direct risk decisions.
status_basis: Policy is drafted; no real approval or communication took place.
required_evidence: Approved policy and staff acknowledgement.

justification: Named asset owners are needed to evaluate information dependencies.
status_basis: Ten assets are inventoried in the case study; completeness is not operationally verified.
required_evidence: Validated asset inventory with owner review.

justification: Service credentials can expose production if copied or left shared.
status_basis: Secrets inventory and rotation evidence are absent.
required_evidence: Credential lifecycle procedure, scoped access and rotation logs.

justification: Leavers, role changes and shared folders require permission decisions.
status_basis: Synthetic access review completed; recurring and organization-wide operation is unverified.
required_evidence: Approval, review and revocation records across all relevant systems.

justification: Data handling suppliers require assessed security expectations.
status_basis: Supplier assessments and reviewed terms are absent.
required_evidence: Supplier risk review and agreed handling conditions.

justification: Cloud use creates service and data dependencies even when operation is outsourced.
status_basis: Cloud responsibility and exit reviews are absent.
required_evidence: Cloud responsibility matrix, service review and exit plan.

justification: Ad hoc reporting needs a defined escalation path.
status_basis: Incident procedure and tabletop evidence are absent.
required_evidence: Incident roles, escalation criteria and exercise records.

justification: Containment and recovery decisions must be timely and recorded.
status_basis: No incident-response exercise has been performed.
required_evidence: Investigation timeline, containment decisions and recovery review.

justification: Service and data recovery need tested business-driven targets.
status_basis: Recovery arrangements have not been exercised.
required_evidence: Approved recovery targets and timed exercise results.

justification: Tickets and people records contain personal information.
status_basis: Jurisdiction and binding obligations require future validation.
required_evidence: Verified obligations register and data-handling rules.

justification: Staff must understand loss reporting and safe information sharing.
status_basis: The portfolio learning guide is not company staff-training evidence.
required_evidence: Role-based training attendance and understanding checks.

justification: Employment changes must trigger updated access and responsibilities.
status_basis: One departed account was corrected in synthetic records; end-to-end HR operation remains planned.
required_evidence: HR trigger, system-owner confirmation and recurring reconciliation.

justification: Remote employees use company devices outside company premises.
status_basis: Home-working device protection is assumed, not evidenced.
required_evidence: Offsite handling instructions and device accountability.

justification: Laptops can expose work sessions and stored information.
status_basis: Encryption and management coverage are unverified.
required_evidence: Device configuration and compliance reports.

justification: Powerful permissions must be justified and independently approved.
status_basis: One unnecessary admin role removed; one approved cloud admin retained in synthetic records.
required_evidence: Privileged approvals, least-privilege review and activity monitoring.

justification: Human and service identities protect sensitive systems.
status_basis: MFA coverage and service authentication are not technically tested.
required_evidence: Authentication settings, coverage report and test results.

justification: Reliable cloud settings support resilience and prevent unintended changes.
status_basis: A configuration baseline is not evidenced.
required_evidence: Approved baseline, drift review and change records.

justification: Ticket recovery requires more than a successful scheduled backup job.
status_basis: No restore has been run in this portfolio.
required_evidence: Backup results, isolated copy and integrity-checked restore.

justification: Privileged changes and incidents need usable records.
status_basis: Log coverage, retention and review are not demonstrated.
required_evidence: Log coverage matrix, protected records and review evidence.

justification: Tenant isolation and build credentials need security throughout development.
status_basis: Security requirements and checks are proposed.
required_evidence: Security acceptance criteria and tests across the development lifecycle.

justification: Production changes require review and recoverability.
status_basis: Release and rollback evidence are not present.
required_evidence: Approved change, test outcome and rollback record.
